mission.title: openyurt: [feature request] Add Claude Code Skills for deploying OpenYurt and configuring Raven
mission.description: [feature request] Add Claude Code Skills for deploying OpenYurt and configuring Raven. Community-requested feature.

steps.title: Check current openyurt deployment
steps.description:
Verify your openyurt version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n openyurt -l app.kubernetes.io/name=openyurt
helm list -n openyurt 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working openyurt installation.

steps.title: Review openyurt configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant openyurt configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n openyurt -l app.kubernetes.io/name=openyurt
kubectl get configmap -n openyurt -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=openyurt
```
[Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) is an AI coding assistant that supports **Skills** — slash commands defined as Markdown files in `.claude/commands/`.

steps.title: Apply the fix for [feature request] Add Claude Code Skills for deploying…
steps.description:
## Proposal: Implement Claude Code Skills for OpenYurt Deployment

Hi, I'm the author of this issue. I want to propose a concrete implementation for team discussion before opening a PR.

---

### Proposed Implementation

#### Structure

I propose using the Claude Code **skill** format rather than
```yaml
The entrypoint file stays short; the reference docs hold the detail. This keeps the skill maintainable: a Helm chart parameter change only requires editing one reference file, not hunting through a monolithic command file.

#### Frontmatter and `allowed-tools` scope
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n openyurt -l app.kubernetes.io/name=openyurt
kubectl get events -n openyurt --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "[feature request] Add Claude Code Skills for deploying…" is functioning correctly.
